mapper.select: SELECT a.*, u.username, ad.username AS admin_name, p.type AS punish_type, p.reason AS punish_reason FROM appeal a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN user ad ON a.review_admin = ad.user_id LEFT JOIN punishment p ON a.punish_id = p.punish_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.appeal_id DESC

SELECT a.*, u.username, ad.username AS admin_name, p.type AS punish_type, p.reason AS punish_reason FROM appeal a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN user ad ON a.review_admin = ad.user_id LEFT JOIN punishment p ON a.punish_id = p.punish_id WHERE a.appeal_id = #{appealId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appeal WHERE punish_id = #{punishId} AND status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO appeal (punish_id, user_id, content, evidence, status, appeal_time) VALUES (#{punishId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{evidence}, 1, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE appeal SET status = #{status}, review_admin = #{reviewAdmin}, review_opinion = #{reviewOpinion}, review_time = NOW() WHERE appeal_id = #{appealId} AND status = 1
